sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-38862'
gated_sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets AS t JOIN crm_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.duns_number = a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id = 'SR-38862' LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id='SR-38862' ORDER BY julianday(at)

sql: SELECT credit_id, ticket_id, ticket_opened, amount_usd, approved_on FROM service_credits WHERE account_id='CRM-2048' ORDER BY approved_on, credit_id

sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.opened_at, t.product_sku, t.channel, t.restored_at, (SELECT group_concat(e.at||' '||e.actor||': '||e.detail, ' | ') FROM ticket_events e WHERE e.ticket_id=t.ticket_id AND e.event='credit_claim') claims FROM service_tickets t WHERE t.account_id='CRM-2048' AND julianday(t.opened_at) BETWEEN julianday('2026-02-28T00:00:00-06:00') AND julianday('2026-04-02T00:00:00-05:00') ORDER BY julianday(t.opened_at)
gated_sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.opened_at, t.product_sku, t.channel, t.restored_at, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(e.at || ' ' || e.actor || ': ' || e.detail, ' | ') FROM ticket_events AS e WHERE e.ticket_id = t.ticket_id AND e.event = 'credit_claim') AS claims FROM service_tickets AS t WHERE t.account_id = 'CRM-2048' AND JULIANDAY(t.opened_at) BETWEEN JULIANDAY('2026-02-28T00:00:00-06:00') AND JULIANDAY('2026-04-02T00:00:00-05:00') ORDER BY JULIANDAY(t.opened_at) LIMIT 200
